integrity: The ray and maximal-cone counts are exact finite orbit computations from the explicit generators in the primary source. Standard smooth-projective toric facts then give the Picard rank, Euler characteristic, and Betti numbers. The verifier does not substitute for the source's proofs of smoothness, projectivity, or completeness.
scientific_limitations: The calculation gives additive cohomological ranks for the split toric Demazure model only. It does not compute the cohomology or Chow ring structure, intersection theory, K-groups, or cohomology of quotients by Galois splitting groups.
title: Betti numbers of the \(A_4\) Demazure model
